newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK MIXED AGAINST UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK MIXED AGAINST UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar finished the week firmer on the U.S. dollar and the mark but was quoted weaker against sterling and the rand after a lacklustre interbank trading session, dealers said.
"To be quite honest nothing much happened today. It was a very quiet market," commented one dealer.
The local unit closed at 10.5650/5850 against the U.S. dollar, up from Thursday's 10.5750/5950 and was also firmer on the mark at 6.9600/9800 compared to 6.9800/9950.

However, it weakened against pound sterling to 17.3500/3900 from 17.1980/2410 -- reflecting an easier U.S. dollar against the British currency overseas -- and was also softer at 2.2800/3000 from 2.2430/2500 against South Africa's rand.
